NFPA 72.question: Panel shows NORMAL (no alarm / supervisory / trouble)
Panel time/date correct; no unexpected disables/bypasses
Review last 7 days event history; record notable entries
Releasing zones: correct ARM/AUTO status as designed
Remote status/control units: normal state; no comms fault
ASD: no airflow/filter/fan faults; display normal
ASD sampling points visually unobstructed (walk-by)
Gas termination unit (GTU): indicators normal (healthy/power)
Visual: damage, water ingress, corrosion, loose glands, access blocked

NFPA 2001.question: Cylinders: general condition OK (no damage/corrosion/leaks); access clear
Cylinder pressure indication in normal range
Cylinder/valve safety devices, pins, tamper seals intact
Discharge piping/nozzles: visually intact, no obstructions/paint/damage
Protected enclosure: doors normally closed, no new penetrations
Pressure relief vent (if installed): unobstructed
Warning signage visible and intact

NFPA 72.question: Panel enclosure: locks/labels/circuit legends intact; clean
Power supply visual: AC present; charger normal LEDs
Battery visual: no swelling/leak/corrosion; terminals tight
Point detectors: correct location/orientation; not painted/covered
Point detectors: environment OK (dust/steam/airflow changes)
ASD pipework: supports intact; joints secure; no damage
ASD filter condition checked
Remote status/control units: lamp test / indication test
GTU wiring/terminations visually sound
Housekeeping: access clear; signage/zone chart present

NFPA 2001.question: Cylinder bank: record pressure and ambient temperature
Cylinder mounting/brackets: secure, no movement
Manifold/check valves/discharge hoses: condition OK
Actuation devices: solenoid/pneumatic actuators intact
Pilot cylinder: pressure in range; tubing intact
Manual release station(s): accessible, labeled
Abort/Hold switch: accessible, labeled
Protected enclosure changes: HVAC, ceiling, etc.

NFPA 72.question: Battery: measure float voltage and record
Check detector spacing (room changes or layout changes)
Check ASD airflow and thresholds
Test one device per zone: ensure panel reacts correctly

NFPA 2001.question: Discharge nozzle alignment check
Check protected volume integrity
Check cylinder pressure trend compared to previous logs

NFPA 72.question: Test 100% of detection devices
Test manual call points / release buttons
Test ASD per manufacturer procedure
Check panel firmware/software and documentation updates

NFPA 2001.question: Weigh cylinders or use pressure-to-weight conversion
Check discharge hoses, seals, and flexible components
Enclosure integrity test (door fan or equivalent)
Review maintenance logs for trends

Is the fire system set to auto/manual mode
